faqData.q: What is your core analytics expertise?
faqData.a: I specialize in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Product & Operational Analytics, KPI Reporting, SQL query optimization, and dashboard development using Power BI and Tableau.

faqData.q: What visualization tools do you work with?
faqData.a: I work extensively with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service) and Tableau to create interactive executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and drill-through reports.

faqData.q: How do you automate reporting workflows?
faqData.a: I use Python, Pandas, SQL, Google BigQuery, and Cloud Functions to automate recurring data preparation, schedule refreshes, and streamline data pipelines.

faqData.q: How do you ensure data accuracy in reporting?
faqData.a: I implement source-to-report reconciliation, data profiling, deduplication, fuzzy matching, and root-cause analysis controls that sustain 98%+ reporting accuracy.

faqData.q: How can I get in touch with you?
faqData.a: You can send a message using the form above or email me directly at atejeswarasaia@gmail.com or call +1 (561) 599-4577.
